# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 platform update**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 while extending support for current .NET and Tizen toolchains. This release refreshes the bundled renderer, aligns WebAssembly assets with .NET 11 previews, and restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 156 and includes the m155 core fork cleanup in the current release line. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies font discovery restored** — Applications using the Linux NoDependencies packages can again discover fonts provided by the operating system. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Current runtime and native platform assets aligned** — Aligns .NET 11 preview package support and WebAssembly native assets, adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with pixel scaling, and updates Tizen packaging for GCC 14.2. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306), [#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249), [#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
